units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A close-up at eye level; the camera slides laterally with small amplitude in shallow focus, easing in at the start and settling to a stop at the end. A dense field of separate round points of warm gold light holding across the whole frame, every point small and round and distinct, the points drifting apart at the slowest breath, a faint milky band of star dust crossing behind them and staying soft. Warm 2000 Taiwanese telecine grade, warm skin tones, milky lifted blacks. Visible 35mm film grain. Restrained continuous motion, camera and subject motion only.
